mike-netter.text: Wants to cut income taxes by 28% for people earning $150,000 or less, saying it "will only cost the state $9 billion a year."

source.title: State Senate Candidate Mike Netter: It's Time to Undo a lot of Bad Laws (California Globe)

mike-netter.text: Says legislators with no business experience pass "1,500 to 2,000 new laws every year" that hurt small businesses and expand government.

source.title: State Senate Candidate Mike Netter (California Globe)

mike-netter.text: On crime: "The laws we have need to be followed"; emphasizes enforcing existing laws over passing new ones.

source.title: State Senate Candidate Mike Netter (California Globe)

mike-netter.text: On homelessness: "It is wrong to live on the streets and we are going to empower you to deal with them"; argues state officials should work in communities rather than micromanage from above.

source.title: State Senate Candidate Mike Netter (California Globe)

mike-netter.text: On elections: opposes permanent absentee ballots, supports removing voters from the rolls after they skip two elections, and questions whether online registrations are legitimate.

source.title: State Senate Candidate Mike Netter (California Globe)
